```go
import "github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/foundry"
```

Package foundry implements Known Foundry named caller\-key Live creation. Importing it requires the dnsid\_foundry build tag. The package remains gated until the server's named\-Live requirements are released. Core DNSid, ordinary registration, and configuration loading do not depend on it.

<a name="Dependencies"></a>
## type [Dependencies](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/foundry/foundry.go#L40-L48>)

Dependencies supplies explicit runtime dependencies. Injected providers, registry clients, and log registries take precedence over loaded selection. Credential is used only by the authenticated registry client and is never saved.

```go
type Dependencies struct {
    Credential     string
    KeyProvider    dnsid.KeyProvider
    RegistryClient RegistryClient
    LogRegistry    *dnsidlog.LogRegistry
    Store          FoundryStore
    DNSResolver    dnsid.DNSResolver
    HTTPSFetcher   dnsid.HTTPSFetcher
}
```


<a name="KeyMissing"></a>Workflow failure categories. Server wire codes remain unchanged in Error.Code.

```go
const (
    KeyMissing           ErrorKind = "KEY_MISSING"

    WorkflowOutcome      ErrorKind = "workflow_outcome"

)
```

<a name="FoundryLease"></a>
## type [FoundryLease](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/foundry/store.go#L29-L33>)

FoundryLease owns an exclusive operation until Close. Load returns nil only when no document exists. Save must be atomic, durable, and owner\-only.

```go
type FoundryLease interface {
    Load(context.Context) (*RecoveryDocument, error)
    Save(context.Context, *RecoveryDocument) error
    Close() error
}
```

<a name="FoundryStore"></a>
## type [FoundryStore](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/foundry/store.go#L23-L25>)

FoundryStore serializes each workflow call and provides durable named state. A lease must prevent writes after Close, including writes from another process.

```go
type FoundryStore interface {
    Lock(context.Context, OperationKey) (FoundryLease, error)
}
```

<a name="IssuanceState"></a>
## type [IssuanceState](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/foundry/document.go#L69-L75>)

IssuanceState retains local coordinator state separately from a verified accepted entry recovered from another replica. Its receipt never acknowledges the local entry bytes.

```go
type IssuanceState struct {
    Operation         *c2sptlog.ManagedIssuanceState `json:"operation,omitempty"`
    Recovered         bool                           `json:"recovered,omitempty"`
    AcceptedReference string                         `json:"acceptedReference,omitempty"`
    PreparedBytes     string                         `json:"preparedBytes,omitempty"`
    StatusCode        int                            `json:"statusCode,omitempty"`
}
```

<a name="RecoveryDocument"></a>
## type [RecoveryDocument](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/foundry/document.go#L26-L54>)

RecoveryDocument is the non\-secret, portable recovery state for an exact name. Use ParseRecoveryDocument and Export to validate imported and exported state.

```go
type RecoveryDocument struct {
    SchemaVersion     int                      `json:"schemaVersion"`
    Phase             string                   `json:"phase"`
    RegistryURL       string                   `json:"registryUrl"`
    OrganizationID    string                   `json:"organizationId"`
    Name              string                   `json:"name"`
    GovernanceID      string                   `json:"governanceId"`
    LogTrust          json.RawMessage          `json:"logTrust,omitempty"`
    KeySource         config.KeySource         `json:"keySource"`
    CurrentKeySource  *config.KeySource        `json:"currentKeySource,omitempty"`
    InitialPublicKey  json.RawMessage          `json:"initialPublicKey"`
    CurrentPublicKey  json.RawMessage          `json:"currentPublicKey,omitempty"`
    CreationInput     CreationInput            `json:"creationInput"`
    IdentityID        string                   `json:"identityId,omitempty"`
    Domain            string                   `json:"domain,omitempty"`
    RegistrationKey   string                   `json:"registrationKey"`
    IssuanceKey       string                   `json:"issuanceKey"`
    RegistryStatus    string                   `json:"registryStatus,omitempty"`
    RegistryError     *dnsid.AgentError        `json:"registryError,omitempty"`
    ProtocolState     string                   `json:"protocolState,omitempty"`
    SigningPaused     bool                     `json:"signingPaused,omitempty"`
    PublicationConfig *dnsid.PublicationConfig `json:"publicationConfig,omitempty"`
    OIDCIssuerURL     string                   `json:"oidcIssuerUrl,omitempty"`
    EntityPublicKey   json.RawMessage          `json:"entityPublicKey,omitempty"`
    Issuance          *IssuanceState           `json:"issuance,omitempty"`
    // RejectedCreation is diagnostic evidence, never an identity binding.
    RejectedCreation *dnsid.CreateAgentResponse `json:"rejectedCreation,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
